writing:fc:7.hint: 風邪をひく動作を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:7.question: I _____ last week after the rain.
writing:fc:7.fullSentence: I caught a cold last week after the rain.

writing:fc:8.hint: 何かをすでにつかんでいる状態を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:8.question: He _____ the rope tightly during the storm.
writing:fc:8.fullSentence: He held the rope tightly during the storm.
writing:fc:8.explanation: 状態的な用法。つかむ動作はget hold of。

writing:fc:9.hint: すでに眠っている状態を表す1語の動詞は何か。
writing:fc:9.question: The baby is _____ peacefully now.
writing:fc:9.fullSentence: The baby is sleeping peacefully now.
writing:fc:9.explanation: 状態。眠りに落ちる動作はfall asleep。

writing:fc:10.hint: 眠りに落ちる、という動作を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:10.question: I _____ on the sofa while watching TV.
writing:fc:10.fullSentence: I fell asleep on the sofa while watching TV.
writing:fc:10.explanation: 動作。眠っている状態はsleep/be asleep。

writing:fc:11.hint: ある集団や場所に所属している、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:11.question: This book _____ the school library.
writing:fc:11.fullSentence: This book belongs to the school library.

writing:fc:12.hint: 時間の経過によって、ある状態に変化するようになるという意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:12.question: She _____ understand his feelings after years.
writing:fc:12.fullSentence: She came to understand his feelings after years.
writing:fc:12.explanation: come to Vで「~するようになる」という変化を表す。

writing:fc:13.hint: 何かをした後で後悔している、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:13.question: He _____ he had not studied harder.
writing:fc:13.fullSentence: He regretted that he had not studied harder.
writing:fc:13.explanation: 後悔の内容をthat節で述べる。

writing:fc:14.hint: 提案や意見に賛成しない、という意味の1語の動詞は何か。
writing:fc:14.question: Many experts _____ with this new policy.
writing:fc:14.fullSentence: Many experts disagree with this new policy.
writing:fc:14.explanation: 賛成しないという意味。refuseは申し出などを拒む場合に使う。

writing:fc:15.hint: 考えや気持ちを言葉に出して伝える、という意味の動詞は何か。
writing:fc:15.question: It is important to _____ your feelings honestly.
writing:fc:15.fullSentence: It is important to express your feelings honestly.
writing:fc:15.explanation: 自分の考えや感情を表す動詞。

writing:fc:16.hint: 時間を無駄にせず、何かをするために使うという意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:16.question: I _____ an hour reading this novel.
writing:fc:16.fullSentence: I spent an hour reading this novel.

writing:fc:17.hint: 何かに良い影響や悪い影響を持つ、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:17.question: 次の状況を最もよく表す英語表現を選びなさい。
writing:fc:17.fullSentence: Sleep deprivation can have a negative effect on health.
writing:fc:17.explanation: 影響を及ぼすという意味の表現。

writing:fc:18.hint: 何かを誤って別の物だと思い込む、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:18.question: I _____ his older brother.
writing:fc:18.fullSentence: I mistook him for his older brother.
writing:fc:18.explanation: mistake A for Bで「AをBと間違える」。

writing:fc:19.hint: できる限り多くの努力をする、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:19.question: She _____ to finish the project on time.
writing:fc:19.fullSentence: She made every effort to finish the project on time.
writing:fc:19.explanation: 最大限努力するという意味の表現。

writing:fc:20.hint: ある分野について広く知識がある、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:20.question: He _____ ancient history.
writing:fc:20.fullSentence: He knows a lot about ancient history.
writing:fc:20.explanation: 詳しいという意味の表現。

writing:fc:21.hint: 意見や決心を変える、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:21.question: She _____ at the last minute.
writing:fc:21.fullSentence: She changed her mind at the last minute.
writing:fc:21.explanation: 決心や考えを変える動作。

writing:fc:22.hint: 眠っている間に頭の中に映像が浮かぶ現象を経験するという表現は何か。
writing:fc:22.question: I _____ about flying last night.
writing:fc:22.fullSentence: I had a strange dream about flying last night.
writing:fc:22.explanation: 「夢を見る」はsee ではなくhaveを使う。

writing:fc:23.hint: 答えの出ない問題をうまく解決する、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:23.question: It took him hours to _____ the math problem.
writing:fc:23.fullSentence: It took him hours to solve the math problem.

writing:fc:24.hint: 老朽化した住宅を新しく改装する、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:24.question: They decided to _____ their old house.
writing:fc:24.fullSentence: They decided to renovate their old house.
writing:fc:24.explanation: reformは英語では「改革する」の意味になるため注意。

writing:fc:25.hint: 試験中に不正な方法で答えを得る、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:25.question: It is forbidden to _____ an exam.
writing:fc:25.fullSentence: It is forbidden to cheat on an exam.
writing:fc:25.explanation: 試験でずるをする行為。

writing:fc:26.hint: 難しい課題に対して自分から取り組んでみる、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:26.question: He decided to _____ solve the puzzle himself.
writing:fc:26.fullSentence: He decided to try to solve the puzzle himself.
writing:fc:26.explanation: challengeは「~に挑む」という他動詞用法とは異なるため注意。

writing:fc:27.hint: 誕生日などのお祝いの会を催す、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:27.question: They are going to _____ this weekend.
writing:fc:27.fullSentence: They are going to have a party this weekend.

writing:fc:28.hint: 以前は行っていたが今はしていない習慣を述べる表現は何か。
writing:fc:28.question: He _____ play soccer every weekend when he was young.
writing:fc:28.fullSentence: He used to play soccer every weekend when he was young.
writing:fc:28.explanation: 過去の習慣・状態を表す。

writing:fc:29.hint: 自転車に乗って学校に行く、という日常的な行動を表す表現は何か。
writing:fc:29.question: Many students _____ every morning.
writing:fc:29.fullSentence: Many students cycle to school every morning.
writing:fc:29.explanation: 自転車で通学する表現。

writing:fc:30.hint: 議論の末に、最終的には、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:30.question: _____, we decided to cancel the trip.
writing:fc:30.fullSentence: After all, we decided to cancel the trip.
writing:fc:30.explanation: 結局は、という意味の副詞句。

writing:fc:31.hint: ある事柄が実現する可能性がある、という意味の表現は何か。
writing:fc:31.question: There is a _____ it will rain tomorrow.
writing:fc:31.fullSentence: There is a possibility that it will rain tomorrow.
writing:fc:31.explanation: 可能性を表す名詞構文。
